name: deepseek
description: DeepSeek's harness (dsh) on Atlas's workbench: the dsh installed on this computer working in your folders for you or for Atlas, on a DeepSeek API key; what it asks reaches you through Atlas. dsh sends DeepSeek its session logs (messages, tools, paths) by default: in the sessions Atlas opens they are off unless the session_logs setting turns them on. It reads your balance from DeepSeek with the key.

secrets.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
secrets.description: A DeepSeek API key, which dsh bills its requests to. Create one on DeepSeek's platform and paste it; without it, dsh uses the key it keeps itself.

settings.name: program
settings.description: The dsh program to run, as a JSON list of the program and the arguments before dsh's own; empty, the dsh on the PATH or where npm put it.

settings.name: session_logs
settings.description: Whether the sessions Atlas opens send DeepSeek their logs, as dsh does by default: on or off.
